 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v})
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    # Each color has two objects; reflect each object vertically across center of canvas.
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        seen = set()
        components = []
        points = set(pts)
        for p in pts:
            if p in seen:
                continue
            comp = []
            stack = [p]
            seen.add(p)
            while stack:
                r, c = stack.pop()
                comp.append((r, c))
                for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if q in points and q not in seen:
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            components.append(comp)
        # Both objects of a color are mirrored vertically, retaining columns.
        for r, c in pts:
            out[h - 1 - r][c] = color
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
